cause_quote: The diff placed `<LightboxFooter originalUrl={props.originalUrl} resolvingOriginal={props.resolvingOriginal} />` after `{props.children}`, moving the pending link to the last position in the controls used for keyboard wrapping.
user_saw: Pressing Shift+Tab from Close in a video gallery focused the unusable Open in new tab link while its destination was loading.
summary: The fix excludes controls with a negative tab index from the lightbox’s keyboard wrap boundaries.
reasoning: I checked the causing commit and its parent: the pending link was previously before Close, so Shift+Tab from Close skipped the link through normal browser traversal. Moving the link to the footer made it the last action, and the existing focus trap called `last.focus()` on it despite its `tabindex=-1`. The later refactor preserved document order and carried the defect forward.
